skill.name: ena-database
skill.description: Access the European Nucleotide Archive for sequence metadata, records, FASTA data, taxonomy lookups, and bulk genomics downloads.
skill.summary: Query ENA APIs and plan sequence data retrieval for genomics workflows.
skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: The skill documents legitimate access to public European Nucleotide Archive APIs and does not contain prompt injection or hidden command execution. Most static findings are expected public API URLs or Markdown examples. The remaining confirmed issue is the recommendation to use plain FTP for bulk downloads, which lacks transport security and should be paired with stronger integrity guidance or safer transfer methods.

remediation.issue: Plain FTP is recommended for bulk sequence downloads.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer HTTPS or Aspera when available, and require checksum verification for any FTP downloads before analysis.

content.value_statement: Researchers need reliable access to sequence records, metadata, and bulk files from ENA. This skill guides Claude and Claude Code through ENA APIs, accession lookups, taxonomy queries, and download planning.
actual_capabilities: Explain ENA data types such as studies, samples, runs, assemblies, sequences, analyses, and taxa.
Construct Portal API searches for metadata, accessions, result types, and selected fields.
Guide Browser API retrieval for XML, text, and FASTA records by accession.
Describe taxonomy and cross-reference lookups through ENA REST endpoints.
Plan bulk download workflows using file reports, FTP, Aspera, or enaBrowserTools.
Recommend rate limiting, pagination, retries, and response handling for API workflows.
limitations: It does not authenticate to private repositories or restricted datasets.
It does not execute downloads unless the user runs the generated commands or code.
It depends on current ENA API behavior and public endpoint availability.
It does not validate biological conclusions from retrieved data.

use_cases.title: Find samples for a study
use_cases.description: Build an ENA Portal API query that lists samples, fields, formats, and pagination settings for a project accession.

use_cases.title: Retrieve sequence records
use_cases.description: Choose the right Browser API format for XML metadata, EMBL text, or FASTA sequence retrieval by accession.

use_cases.title: Plan bulk read downloads
use_cases.description: Use ENA file reports to identify FASTQ files, checksums, sizes, and safe transfer options for pipeline input.

prompt_templates.title: Look up an accession
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to explain how I can retrieve metadata for accession ERR123456. Include the recommended endpoint and response format.

prompt_templates.title: Search samples by study
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to create a Portal API query for all samples in study PRJNA123456. Return useful fields and explain pagination.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve FASTA sequence data
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to retrieve a FASTA record for accession LN847353. Explain how to request a subsequence range and handle errors.

prompt_templates.title: Design a bulk download workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the ENA database skill to design a bulk FASTQ download workflow for a study accession. Include file report fields, rate limits, checksums, and transfer options.

output_examples.input: Find metadata for all E. coli assemblies with a minimum contig N50.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest an ENA Portal API assembly search using a taxonomy tree query for E. coli, an N50 filter, JSON output, and selected assembly fields.

output_examples.input: Download reads for one run accession.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend using the file report endpoint to get FASTQ URLs, file sizes, and MD5 checksums before choosing a transfer method.

output_examples.input: Get the lineage for taxonomy ID 562.
output_examples.output: The skill would identify the taxonomy REST tax-id endpoint and explain that the response includes taxon ID, scientific name, rank, and lineage.

best_practices: Use specific result types and field lists to reduce response size.
Respect ENA rate limits and use retry backoff for transient server errors.
Verify checksums after downloading FASTQ, BAM, CRAM, or assembly files.
anti_patterns: Do not loop over large accession lists without delays or batching.
Do not parse XML with regular expressions when structured XML parsers are available.
Do not rely on FTP downloads without checksum verification.

faq.question: What is the European Nucleotide Archive?
faq.answer: ENA is a public repository for nucleotide sequences, raw reads, assemblies, annotations, samples, studies, and related metadata.

faq.question: Can this skill download data for me?
faq.answer: It can guide API calls and download workflows. Actual downloads require the user or environment to run the generated commands or code.

faq.question: Which ENA API should I use for metadata searches?
faq.answer: Use the Portal API for flexible searches across result types, fields, filters, formats, and pagination.

faq.question: Which ENA API should I use for a known accession?
faq.answer: Use the Browser API when you already know an accession and need XML, text, or FASTA records.

faq.question: Does it support taxonomy lookups?
faq.answer: Yes. It documents taxonomy REST endpoints for taxon IDs, scientific names, and submission suggestions.

faq.question: How should I handle large FASTQ downloads?
faq.answer: Use file reports to collect URLs, sizes, and checksums. Prefer secure transfer options when available and verify downloaded files.
